schema.description: Makes the call safe to repeat (1-100 characters: letters, digits, `_`, `-`). The same key for the same action returns the first result without running it again (response header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); for another action it is refused with 422. Keys are kept 7 days.

assignee.description: Leave it out (the default) for all open tasks of the family, also when the person says "give me" or "show me the open tasks" (that is who gets the answer, not whose tasks). post.description: Items already on the list are not duplicated (a new quantity replaces the old one; an empty one keeps it); bought items come back. Without a category, the one last used for the product is reused.

listId.description: Target list; omit for the first (default) list

list.description: The list by the name the person used, when you do not have its id; an unknown name is refused with the real names. Omit both for the default list

quantity.description: How much, as written: a number, a count or a measure, e.g. "2 kg", "3" or "a dozen". Never a word that describes the product ("new", "big"); omit it when no amount is given

category.description: Store section; omit to reuse the last one used for this product
